title: FlapLab Daily — One Hour of Oxygen
story: You went diving off the California coast and a sperm whale swallowed you whole. One hour of oxygen. The only way out is between the teeth — and the jaw keeps closing.
inspiration: Dark Jonah fable riffing on 'Whalefall' (released 16 Oct 2026: a diver trapped inside a sperm whale with an hour of oxygen; X Trending 'Whalefall Thriller Divides Audiences with Tears and Intensity', x.com/i/trending/2110900650255003739). ISO week 43 odd → story. Scuba diver + sperm whale tooth (Wikimedia, rembg; tooth flips into an upper jaw), deep-blue ocean (Wikimedia). Slow, floaty underwater flap.
